title: PDF to Semantic HTML
sourceTableContract: The decorations command exports ruled and fill-partitioned tables with source page widths, cell spans, fills, individual borders, vertical alignment and uniform typography. JSON is flushed before exit.
summary: Converts born-digital PDFs to semantic positioned HTML and local assets. Checks technical output assembly and resource loading only; bookValidated is always false. Manuscript fidelity and book acceptance belong exclusively to validateBook. Supports a hash-verified prepared runtime for read-only mounts.
conversionContract: Conversion performs technical assembly checks only: nonempty generated content, complete page containers and serialized region counts, safe local assets, image decoding, font loading and browser loading errors. Reports use scope=conversion-technical and bookValidated=false. Text fidelity, punctuation, reading order, source-image correspondence, typography, positioning, clipping and overflow are book-validation responsibilities and never determine conversion acceptance. A successful conversion must be handed to validateBook before publication. Technical failures retain diagnostic output; installation checks the final path before discarding recovery copies.
punctuationRestoration: Exact local source alignment with bounded unique-context resumption; preserve unmatched words and restore source compound hyphens; folios retain extractor page provenance.
